command:
set -eu
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  opts=$(findmnt -no OPTIONS "$d")
  case ",$opts," in *,nosuid,*nodev,*noexec,*) : ;; *) printf 'BAD_OPTIONS %s %s\n' "$d" "$opts"; exit 1;; esac
  test "$(stat -c %a "$d")" = 1777
  t="$d/.hardening-write-test"
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$t"
  chmod 755 "$t"
  if "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'EXEC_UNEXPECTEDLY_SUCCEEDED %s\n' "$d"; rm -f "$t"; exit 1; else rc=$?; fi
  rm -f "$t"
  printf 'HEALTHY %s OPTIONS=%s MODE=1777 WRITABLE=yes DIRECT_EXEC_RC=%s\n' "$d" "$opts" "$rc"
done
printf 'FSTAB_TMP='; findmnt -s -F /etc/fstab -n -o SOURCE,TARGET,FSTYPE,OPTIONS --target /tmp
printf 'FSTAB_SHM='; findmnt -s -F /etc/fstab -n -o SOURCE,TARGET,FSTYPE,OPTIONS --target /dev/shm
printf 'BASELINE_OK\n'
